Met Office predicts certain extreme weather in UK linked to El Niño

The United Kingdom's Met Office issued a forecast concerning the impact of the El Niño climate phenomenon. The agency said there is a 100% probability of extreme weather conditions across the UK. The forecast links the expected extreme weather directly to the El Niño event. The announcement was reported by international news services such as The Independent and the Daily Mirror.
